name: loop-foundry
description: Turn repeated work into portable AI skills, evaluations, and safe automation recipes.

interface.shortDescription: Forge repeated work into reusable AI skills.
interface.longDescription: Loop Foundry interviews users, separates training and heldout examples, defines acceptance criteria, improves a workflow through evidence, and produces a safe automation recipe without requiring a separate API key or web service.
interface.defaultPrompt: Interview me and turn my repeated work into a reusable skill and safe automation recipe.
